blocks.text: Bird B Gone: Reflective Eye Bird Diverters - Visual Bird Deterrents - Set of 5

Bid farewell to annoying birds and maintain the sanctity of your space! Bird B Gone's Reflective Eye Bird Diverters are your go-to solution for all bird-related disturbances. Designed to mimic the intimidating eyes of predators and reflect sunlight, these diverters instill a sense of imminent danger in approaching birds. The result? Your spaces—patio, balcony, boat, garden, and more—stay serene and bird-free.

With its tear-drop design, measuring 5" in length and 3.5" in width, these diverters are the perfect fit for a wide range of locations. Whether you're looking to protect house eaves, trees, patios, gazebos, or boats, our Reflective Scare Bird Diverters can be easily installed in seconds. Strategically place them across various points in your space and watch them work their magic.

Made from durable plastic, these hanging diverters stand up against both the sun's rays and downpours, offering unwavering bird-repelling performance year-round without harming trees or plants. The built-in swivel attachment promotes a full 360° rotation, enhancing the repellent effect. This continuous movement, paired with their reflective design, effectively wards off birds from every angle.
Bird B Gone - Your Trusted Bird Control Partner

As a frontrunner in avian control products, Bird B Gone is committed to delivering only the best in innovative and humane bird deterrents, live traps, scare devices, and repellents. Our wide range of high-quality, user-friendly products caters to both homes and businesses. Trust Bird B Gone to be your ultimate partner for keeping unwanted birds at bay!

items.label: SCARE BIRDS AWAY
items.value: Bird B Gone's Reflective Eye Bird Diverters are a set of five visual deterrents designed to frighten and divert pesky birds. By mimicking the menacing eyes of predators and reflecting sunlight, these diverters create a sense of danger, making birds think twice before approaching.

items.label: VERSATILE DESIGN
items.value: Whether it's trees, house eaves, gazebos, patios, boats, or overhangs, these Reflective Scare Bird Diverters are adaptable to nearly any space. Their swivel tear-drop design, measuring 5" in length and 3.5" in width, makes them easy to hang wherever you need. Place them strategically across multiple locations on your property to maximize their bird-deterring potential.

items.label: WEATHER RESISTANT DETERRENT
items.value: Made of durable plastic suitable for year-round outdoor use, these iridescent foil predator eye scare diverters are built to endure the elements. Whether it's rain or shine, their reflective repellent properties remain unaffected. Plus, they're gentle on nature, causing no harm to trees or plants wherever they're hung.

items.label: 360° ROTATION
items.value: Featuring a swivel attachment, each bird diverter has the capability to rotate a full 360 degrees, enhancing the bird-deterrent effect. Hang them freely using the provided twine or rope to ensure optimal rotation and boost their ability to keep your space bird-free. When no longer needed, the diverters can be easily removed and stored for future use.

items.label: TRUST BIRD B GONE
items.value: A leader in avian control products, Bird B Gone is dedicated to providing our customers only the highest quality innovative bird deterrents, repellents, and scare devices for homes and businesses that are user-friendly, effective, and humane. See how Bird B Gone is the best way to keep birds away!
